# rypipe Documentation

> Format-agnostic columnar engine. Parse row-oriented byte streams into Apache Arrow record batches with a Rust core, Python bindings, parallel scheduling, memory-bounded execution, and query pushdown.

## Overview
- [rypipe](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/): Format-agnostic columnar engine that turns byte streams into Arrow record batches

## Tutorial
- [Tutorial index](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/tutorial/): Install rypipe + an adapter, read your first file
- [First Steps](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/tutorial/first-steps/): rypipe.read() in depth — format inference, kwargs, schema hints
- [Pipeline](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/tutorial/pipeline/): Chain stages with the | operator
- [Stages](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/tutorial/stages/): CastTypes, FilterRows, RenameFields, DropFields reference
- [Sinks](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/tutorial/sinks/): to_arrow, to_pandas, to_polars, to_parquet, to_csv
- [Streaming](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/tutorial/streaming/): iter_record_batches with bounded memory
- [Configuration](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/tutorial/configuration/): All rypipe.read() kwargs and Source constructor options

## API Reference
- [Python API](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/reference/python-api/): rypipe.read, Source, Adapter, Pipeline, stages, sinks, exceptions
- [Rust API](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/reference/rust-api/): Splitter, RecordParser, ColumnarSink, ExecutionPlan, Pipeline, Value

## Writing Adapters
- [Writing Adapters overview](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/writing-adapters/): The crxml formula — Source, Adapter, stages, registration
- [Quick Start](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/writing-adapters/quickstart/): Build a working adapter in 15 minutes
- [Python Wiring](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/writing-adapters/python-wiring/): Source subclass, adapter class, registration, repacked stages
- [Rust Creation](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/writing-adapters/rust-creation/): Splitter, RecordParser, ColumnarSink implementation guide
- [Schema](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/writing-adapters/schema/): Schema declaration for maximum performance
- [Techniques](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/writing-adapters/techniques/): Performance optimizations for production adapters
- [Anti-patterns](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/writing-adapters/anti-patterns/): Common mistakes to avoid
- [Examples](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/writing-adapters/examples/): Worked CSV, JSONL, and TSV adapters

## Examples
- [Examples](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/examples/): Python and Rust API recipes for reading, pipelines, adapters, and sinks
- [crxml adapter](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/crxml-adapter/): Real-world adapter example; Crystal Reports XML parser built on rypipe-core

## Advanced
- [Advanced overview](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/): Roadmap and checklist for the advanced section
- [Pushdown fusion](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/fusion/): How stages collapse into an ExecutionPlan
- [Execution modes](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/execution-modes/): Stream, columnar, parallel, and auto engine selection
- [Memory and chunking](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/memory-and-chunking/): Memory budgets and chunk sizing
- [Parallelism](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/parallelism/): rayon internals and measuring speedup
- [Dictionary encoding](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/dictionary-encoding/): Arrow dictionaries and auto_dict
- [Schema and types](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/schema-and-types/): schema_order, field_types, and numeric compare filters
- [I/O tuning](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/io-tuning/): mmap vs buffered reads and storage classes
- [Adapter design](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/adapter-design/): Splitter, RecordParser, memchr, and sink.wants
- [Profiling](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/profiling/): perf, flamegraph, and RSS measurement
- [Anti-patterns](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/anti-patterns/): Common mistakes that hurt throughput and memory
- [Case study: crxml](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/case-study-crxml/): How crxml reaches multi-GB/s throughput

## Internals
- [Architecture](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/architecture/): Splitting, row extraction, typed builders, and engine design
- [Performance](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/performance/): Parallel scheduling, memory budgets, and optimization notes

For the full documentation in a single file, see [llms-full.txt](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/llms-full.txt).
